scenes.title: the dark night and the first lamp
scenes.place: a paper threshold on the darkest night of Kartik
scenes.summary: One hand lights the first diya; a street answers with a row of lamps.

visual.subject: a single diya, then a row of lamps across a paper street
visual.setting: indigo night, a dark doorway, a paper street
visual.action: a hand lights one wick; windows and lamps answer

scenes.title: who is Lakshmi
scenes.place: a lotus pond at the edge of the cosmos
scenes.summary: Lakshmi appears with four arms, a lotus and a gold halo.

visual.subject: Lakshmi, four arms, lotus, gold halo, red and gold sari
visual.setting: a dark lotus pond with a low moon
visual.action: her upper hands raise lotuses; the lower hands rest open

scenes.title: the churning and the choice
scenes.place: the cosmic ocean, Mount Mandara and the court of the gods
scenes.summary: Gods and asuras churn the ocean; treasures rise; Lakshmi appears and chooses Vishnu.

visual.subject: the churning ocean, rising treasures, Lakshmi on a lotus, the garland to Vishnu
visual.setting: a deep indigo ocean, a paper mountain, a gold court
visual.action: the mountain turns, the serpent pulls, the lotus opens, the garland passes

scenes.title: the home and the condition
scenes.place: a courtyard, a doorway, a low puja table
scenes.summary: The home is cleaned and lit; the puja asks for prosperity, and the old stories attach a condition.

visual.subject: rangoli at the door, diyas, a puja thali, a ledger and a coin given
visual.setting: a warm cream courtyard and a low puja table
visual.action: the householder draws and offers; the child lights and receives; Lakshmi blesses

scenes.title: many tellings, one light
scenes.place: three paper windows, then a single flame
scenes.summary: Bengal, Ayodhya and the western account books share the night; the film ends by passing the light.

visual.subject: three windows for Bengal, Ayodhya and the account books; two hands pass one diya
visual.setting: a dark wall with three lit windows, then a close flame
visual.action: three traditions appear; the lamp passes from one hand to another
